name: Run Unit Tests After Each Task
description: Automatically runs pytest on Option B tests after Kiro completes each spec task. If any test fails, Kiro will attempt to fix the failure before moving to the next task.
notes: continueOnFailure is false — Kiro must not proceed to the next task if tests are failing. Tests run against the Option B PySpark engine using local[2] Spark mode. The hook uses pytest return code only (0 = all pass, 1 = failures).
